reviews.title: Very Good Value for a Solid Product
reviews.comment: I've always liked this keyboard.  I bought one for my son a few years ago and I've always wanted one for myself.  I took a chance on this and when I opened it, I couldn't tell the difference between the one I bought for my son brand new and this keyboard.  I would definitely buy from this seller again.
reviews.author: S. Senior

reviews.title: Great Keyboard
reviews.comment: I bought this keyboard over a year ago and have had no problems with it, plus it’s comfortable to my fingers and all the typing I do every day.
reviews.author: Claudia Gonzalez

reviews.title: Great Build Quality
reviews.comment: Great keyboard. Excellent build quality. I have several HyperX keyboards and have used them for years!
reviews.author: Greg Crusco
